title: Hidden Cabinet Outlets: Concealed Under-Cabinet Plugs for a Clean Kitchen

locations.name: Kitchen area (probable)
locations.basis: Transcript discusses backsplashes and cabinets; no explicit shooting location.

summary: This Old House presents a solution to avoid visible electrical outlets on a large kitchen backsplash by installing under-cabinet plug modules. With a stated code requirement of six outlets, the video shows pre-existing wiring and the installers connecting and tucking in modules under each cabinet, achieving a tidy look with no traditional outlet boxes on the backsplash. The demonstration concludes with testing an appliance in use and a brief outro inviting viewers to watch more videos and subscribe.
topics: code requirement for outlets on backsplash

sections.title: Problem framing and proposed concealed outlets
sections.description: The homeowners favor large backsplash pieces and want to avoid visible outlets. The presenters reference a code requirement for six outlets and propose under-cabinet plug modules installed under each cabinet to preserve the backsplash aesthetic.

sections.title: Under-cabinet module installation and wiring
sections.description: Wires are described as already present; the modules are connected and tucked under cabinets, resulting in concealed outlets with power available.

sections.title: Conclusion and call to action
sections.description: The video closes with a typical This Old House outro encouraging viewers to watch more videos and subscribe for updates.
